program.name: Whole Body Week
program.subject: Balanced week
program.blurb: One kettlebell and a mat: bell strength, bell conditioning and a flow, in a four-day rotation.
program.about: A four-day rotation with one kettlebell and a mat, so a run of days covers the whole body. Push, legs and pull days each start with bell strength, then swing or circuit conditioning, then a flow for the same area: shoulders, hips or spine. The full-body day opens with sun salutations and ends with a bell Tabata and abs. Levels II and III add reps, since one bell stays one weight, and every hold in the flows gets longer.
program.split: Push / legs / pull / full body: bell strength, bell conditioning and a flow
